viewer_title: Mapper sensitivity explorer — saved results only

caveats.S: The membership-Jaccard S score is an EXPLORATORY overlap indicator (symmetric mean of best membership-Jaccard matches against the pre-specified reference cell), not a metric and not a canonical Mapper graph similarity; it is greedy, edge-blind, and not normalized for node count. Read it only beside component counts and the graphs themselves; never use it alone to rank cover resolutions.
caveats.cycles: A Mapper graph cycle is NOT automatically a true persistent loop in the data: the no-loop blob control produces short noise-scale graph cycles while its H1 persistence diagram correctly shows no dominant class. Cycle length and scale context distinguish loop-like structure from noise.
caveats.connected: A visually connected graph is NOT automatically the correct interpretation of the underlying dataset, and a fragmented graph is not automatically wrong: both are consequences of the cover resolution and overlap shown in the metadata panel.
caveats.no_participant_study: This viewer makes parameter-dependent structural changes INSPECTABLE side-by-side with provenance. The project has no participant study, so nothing here claims improved human readability in general.

weather.label: NY Central Park daily weather cloud (GSOD 2019-2024)
weather.lens: PCA-1 on the z-scored TEMP/DEWP/SLP cloud (unsupervised)

state_space.note: state-space cloud (TEMP/DEWP/SLP): NO dominant H1 class — the negative representation contrast; the annual signal lives in temporal organization, not static daily-state geometry.

seasonal_reference.note: sliding-window embedding (tau=60, d=8, span 420 d) of the z-scored daily TEMP series: ONE dominant H1 class — consistent with recurrent seasonal or quasi-periodic structure, not proof of a simple closed physical climate trajectory.

weather.ph_note: Two computed-PH views from Extension A: the 3-D state-space cloud (no dominant loop) and the reference sliding-window embedding of the TEMP series (one dominant H1 class). These are different constructions of the same daily observations.

cells.lens_variant_note: Day-of-year lens encodes calendar information directly into the filter function; any apparent seasonal separation under this lens is partially built in and must be read beside the unsupervised PCA-lens result.
